change:
* G1_GATE functional + timing testbench with the sg13g2_IOPadOut30mA pad model and 5 nF external gate load
.param VDDA=3.3 VDD=1.2
.lib <PDK>/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerMOSlv.lib mos_tt
.lib <PDK>/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerMOShv.lib mos_tt
.lib <PDK>/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerRES.lib res_typ
.lib <PDK>/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerCAP.lib cap_typ
.lib <PDK>/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerDIO.lib dio_tt
.include <VERIFICATION_INPUTS>/gate_explicit_spi_preparation_20260923_r2/explicit_body.spi
.include <PROJECT>/designs/g1-guardian/blocks/g1_gate/sim/postlayout/g1_gate_pex.spice
.temp 27
.global sub!
Vsub sub! 0 dc 0
* convergence with the IO pad model: supplies through 0.5 Ohm with 1 nF local decoupling, gear integration
.option method=gear reltol=0.005 itl4=100 abstol=1e-9 vntol=1e-5 chgtol=1e-13
Rsa vdda_s vdda 0.5
Cda vdda 0 1n
Rsd vdd_s vdd 0.5
Cdd vdd 0 1n
Vdda vdda_s 0 pwl(0 0 1u 0 3u 3.3 16u 3.3)
Vdd vdd_s 0 pwl(0 0 5u 0 7u 1.2 16u 1.2)
* stimulus (1.2 V): en high at 0.2us; trip_d pulse at 2us; clr_d pulse at 4us; hard_cmp pulse at 6us (fast_en=0) and 8us (fast_en=1); en low at 10us
Ven en_pad 0 0
XPE en_pad en_core vdd 0 vdda 0 0 G1_VSS_DERIVATIVE__sg13g2_IOPadIn
Vtrip trip_d 0 0
Vclr clr_d 0 0
Vhard hard_cmp 0 0
Vfast fast_en 0 0
XG trip_d clr_d fast_en hard_cmp en_core gate_core fault_core tripped vdd vdda 0 g1_gate
* pads: pad c2p vdd vss iovdd iovss
XPG gate gate_core vdd 0 vdda 0 0 G1_VSS_DERIVATIVE__sg13g2_IOPadOut30mA
XPF fault_n fault_core vdd 0 vdda 0 0 G1_VSS_DERIVATIVE__sg13g2_IOPadOut4mA
* external gate network: 10 Ohm series (board gate resistor) + 5 nF
Rg gate_rg gfet 10
* Vendor model unchanged; D/G/S pin order. Board loads are engineering assumptions.
* Compatibility wrapper supplies the vendor's four unchanged constants because
* legacy PSpice .PARAM name value declarations are not resolved by this parser.
.param ptrc1=3.25e-3 ptrc2=9.0e-6 pwidth=1.3392864 perim=2.7
.incpslt <PROJECT>/build/g1_gate/vendor/CSD16340Q3.lib
Vbus rawbus 0 5
* Conditional manual disconnect: finite resistance, not a clamp.
Rdisconnect rawbus bus 10000000
Ccontact rawbus bus 100p
Cbus bus 0 1.0000000000000001e-05
Rbleed bus 0 10.5k
Rload bus load 5
Lload load drain 1e-07
Vfet drain dfet 0
XFET dfet gfet source CSD16340Q3
Rshunt source kelvin 25m
Rreturn kelvin 0 10m
* Assumed flyback clamp across the R-L load, not a selected board diode.
Dfly drain bus fixture_clamp
.model fixture_clamp D(is=1n n=1 rs=0.05 tt=10n cjo=50p bv=60)
Rpulldown gfet source 10k
Vig gate gate_rg 0
Cfault fault_n 0 20p
Ctrip tripped 0 20f

.save v(xpe.xi0.net4) v(xpe.xi0.net7) v(xpe.xi0.net1) v(xpg.net1) v(xpg.net2) v(xpf.net1) v(xpf.net2) v(gate_core) v(fault_core) v(vdda) v(vdd) v(gate) v(fault_n) v(tripped) v(en_core) v(bus) v(gfet) v(drain) i(vfet)
.tran 1n 16u 0 1n
.end
